attendance.note: Organiser-reported: brightspotCITY 2026 drew 'a record breaking 216.000 visitors in 2 weekends' with 250 brands chosen from close to 3,000 submissions. The spin-off TAMAN Brightspot (Aug 2026) drew 'well over 100,000' per co-founder Anton Wirjono.

last_edition.label: brightspotCITY 2026 (public days 27 to 31 May and 4 to 7 Jun; private opening 26 May)

next_edition.label: brightspotUTOPIA (25 to 29 Nov and 3 to 6 Dec 2026); venue not yet published

add_sources.note: Google snippet of the official Facebook page: 'Instagram: @brightspotmrkt www.brightspotmrkt.com'; site pages (about, partners, tenants) appear in Google results.

@brightspotmrkt (18 Sep 2026): 'A throwback to Brightspot City earlier this year. 2 weekends ... A record breaking 216.000 visitors in 2 weekends and 250 selected brands from close to 3000 submissions.'

@brightspotmrkt 'BRIGHTSPOT UTOPIA' volunteer call: event runs 25 to 29 Nov and 3 to 6 Dec 2026 (9 days); tenant call posts give the same dates (https://www.instagram.com/p/DejFWWFhNTx/).

Two flagship editions in 2026 (brightspotCITY May to Jun; brightspotUTOPIA 'Coming November 2026') plus spin-offs TAMAN Brightspot (Aug) and Sporting Supply MRKT (Aug); frequency set to biannual on the 2026 pattern.
